title: Breakout with volume
intro_say: Angstrom Signals. | Worked example: a breakout with volume.

steps.say: A breakout means more when the structure is already rising, | and when a crowd turns up for it.

steps.screen: Set editor: three single signals: Market structure, Bollinger position, Heavy-volume candle
steps.say: Add three single signals: market structure, Bollinger position, and the heavy-volume candle.

steps.screen: Lines: "Market structure is up", "Bollinger position is at least 1", "Volume ratio is at least 2"
steps.say: Line one: market structure is up. | Line two: the close is at or above the upper Bollinger band. | Line three: today's volume is at least twice the usual.

steps.screen: Save; Prism: + and ▶ on All equities
steps.say: Save it, and run it on your equities.
Yes means all three are true on today's finished candle. | Each No shows which piece is missing.
